html:
The Nguburinji are an Aboriginal people of northwest Queensland, in country south of the Gulf of Carpentaria on the plains inland from Burketown.

Their neighbours on the map include the Waanyi to the west, the Mayi-Kutuna to the east and the Gangalidda on the coast. Cattle runs spread across the Gulf country from the 1860s. Little else is recorded about them as a separate group. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Nguburinji are an Aboriginal people of northwest Queensland, in country south of the Gulf of Carpentaria on the plains inland from Burketown.
